subject: social
name: Social Studies
title: Grade 2 Social Studies: Local Government, Economics & Cultural Diversity
overview: Grade 2 Social Studies builds civic competence, geographical literacy, economic understanding, and historical inquiry aligned with the C3 Framework.
competencies: Investigate historical questions using multiple primary and secondary sources.
Analyze human and physical geography to understand how location and resources shape human decisions.
Explain economic concepts including production, market exchange, trade specialization, and public finance.
Apply democratic principles and civic virtues to deliberate contemporary public issues.

modules.title: Local Government, Taxes & Public Goods
modules.description: Understanding how local mayors, city councils, and police/fire departments serve the community through taxes.

topics.title: How Local Government Works
topics.description: Exploring city hall, local ordinances, and public hearings where citizens speak.

topics.title: Public Goods, Services and Taxes
topics.description: Explaining how public libraries, roads, parks, and schools are funded collectively.

modules.title: Economics: Producers, Consumers & Saving
modules.description: Distinguishing between goods and services, exploring supply and demand, and learning about personal saving and budgeting.

topics.title: Goods, Services and Market Choices
topics.description: Identifying business roles and explaining how scarce resources require economic trade-offs.

topics.title: Earning, Spending and Saving Money
topics.description: Tracking personal earnings, differentiating needs from wants, and setting savings goals.
